messages.subject: CFA with t scores
parts:
Hello,
I have a multidimensional scale. The scale uses t scores obtained from raw scores for each subscale. For instance, Subscale A include 25 items, and the manuel automatically calculates the t scores for this subscale. So, I have a total of 10 t scores representing each subscale and 6 of them are loaded in Construct 1 and 4 of them are loaded in Factor 2. I am planning to run CFA using the previous research and provided factor structure. So, my question is should I use Maximum Likelihood Estimation? I am not sure if I am reading this data correct but I have not done any analysis using t-scores. I do not even know if we can run CFA using this t scores. So, could you please give me a shot? Any reading or examples are appreciated. Also, could you please provide me a correct syntax for this analysis.
Sincerely,
irukeru
